_comments.source: Hand-curated 2026-04-05. Median nerve entrapment at the wrist — the archetypal peripheral neuropathy. Diagnosis via NCS/EMG, treatment via splinting, steroid injection, or open/endoscopic carpal tunnel release.
_comments.hcpcs_rationale: 64721 open carpal tunnel release is the gold-standard surgical code. 29848 is endoscopic release. 20526 is in-office steroid injection. 95905/95860/95886 are the diagnostic NCS/EMG workup. 76882 is diagnostic ultrasound of the median nerve (increasingly used). 99213/99214 E&M are the clinic visits.
_comments.taxonomy_rationale: Hand Surgery (ortho + plastic sub-cert), Orthopedic Surgery, Neurology (NCS interpretation), PM&R (EMG + non-op management), Plastic Surgery (hand), and Clinical Neurophysiology.
_comments.pubmed_rationale: Common and clinical names, diagnostic modality (NCS, ultrasound), treatment modalities (injection, open, endoscopic).
